head.title: Disk Space Cleanup Report
head.summary: Identify reclaimable disk space and copy singine cleanup commands.

section.title: Summary
section.para: The table below lists disk-space consumers on this machine, ranked by size. For each item the singine command that would delete or uninstall it is shown — click the copy button to place it on the clipboard, then paste it into a terminal.
Commands are executed via singine runtime exec-external. High-cost actions (risk = review) will prompt for GOV-007 confirmation before dispatching.

note.para: The Safe items can be deleted immediately. Review items should be verified before deletion. Keep items are listed for visibility only.

listitem.para: Copy the singine command from the table above.
Paste it into a terminal where singine is on the PATH:
listitem.programlisting: npm install -g singine # first time only

listitem.para: For review items, singine will apply GOV-007 and prompt for confirmation before deleting.
